benchmark.one_rotation_semantics: mean of the four actually timed rotations within each run
benchmark.total_scope: RGB already loaded; excludes graph load, source decode and output PNG writes

matching_policy: 4-connected components, Hungarian one-to-one assignment, component IoU >= 0.5; same as legacy
unmatched_prediction_semantics: FP components counts unmatched predictions, including real fingertip subregions with insufficient GT overlap; not synonymous with background false positives
ridge_semantics: unchanged shared validator per raw connected-component crop; mask-only result, no protection or matcher evaluation
structural_evidence: private overlays inspected: no severe wrist, keyboard or background selection in consensus
approval_blockers: coverage below 90 percent and not above legacy 70 percent
DET-03 class 2 absent in all four rotations; class 1 finger body is present
